translation_comparison: French rapid/unplanned/no-rereading and conscious-contribution instructions corroborate essential Seaver/Lane1969 transcription facts. Not a full textual collation or manuscript authentication. French excerpt omits the concentration-setting clause and later continuation/arbitrary-letter restart passage; these are not frozen French-subset rules.
historical_restart: Seaver/Lane online transcription describes an arbitrary-letter restart; only a qualified external reference, not required or verified against French original in this profile.
editorial: All session states/events, optional timestamps/constraints, interruption/restart controls, draft assembly, revisions, metrics and review questions are application conventions.
Stop, pause or omit participation freely; no fixed historical duration, mental-state compliance score or mandatory restart technique.
Revision is a separately labeled creative extension; does not retroactively change the first draft or claim fidelity to a historical first-and-last-draft ideal.
limits: No source-specific spiritualist, ideomotor or stream-of-consciousness procedure implemented.
Moses and Breton/Soupault exemplar remain separate; no generated writing, extraordinary authorship, diagnosis, hidden memories or predictions.
